scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
We are Crusaders that have
been training in preparation
for the Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我們是十字軍，一直在為即將到來的聖戰進行訓練。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As our forefathers have
done a thousand years ago, we shall vanquish the hordes of Demons when the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
正如我們的先輩在一千年前所做的那樣，當那一天到來時，我們將殲滅惡魔大軍。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If you have any questions about Crusaders, feel free to ask me.
I may be too old and weak for fighting, but I will spread our message as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果您對十字軍有任何疑問，請隨時問我。
雖然我可能太老、太弱，無法再戰鬥，但我會盡我所能傳播我們的信念。

scripts.text: What is Holy Cross?
scripts.translation: 什麼是聖十字攻擊？

scripts.text: What is Grand Cross?
scripts.translation: 什麼是聖十字審判？

scripts.text: What is Sacrifice?
scripts.translation: 什麼是犧牲？

scripts.text: What is Gleipnir?
scripts.translation: 什麼是魔法鐵鏈？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Holy Cross is the first manifestation of a Crusader's faith. By making the sign of the cross, Crusader's can inflict a holy attack on their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
聖十字攻擊是十字軍信仰的第一種體現。通過畫十字，十字軍可以對敵人發動神聖攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Monsters that are weak against holiness, particularly the Undead, will be blinded by the light of the Holy Cross. All they can do is wait for holy judgment.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
對神聖屬性脆弱的魔物，特別是不死系，會被聖十字攻擊的光芒致盲。它們只能等待神聖的審判。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Based on our latest research,
the Holy Cross can inflict 4.5 times more damage than a normal attack once it is mastered.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
根據我們最新的研究，聖十字攻擊一旦精通，造成的傷害將是普通攻擊的4.5倍。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Grand Cross...!
The righteous fury of God is
given form in this destructive skill.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
聖十字審判...
上帝的正義之怒，在這個毀滅性的技能中具象化。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
God grants us his power so that
we may punish the forces of evil, and one's rage is embodied in a giant crucifix of power.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
上帝賜予我們力量，讓我們懲罰邪惡勢力，而人的憤怒則化身為巨大的力量十字架。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
The power of the crucifix of light can damage the enemy three times. Each strike will have five times the strength of your normal attacks.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
光之十字架的力量可以對敵人造成三次傷害。每次打擊的威力都是普通攻擊的五倍。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, when Crusaders use Grand Cross, they must exercise extreme caution. The human body is too weak to fully embrace the will of God.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
然而，當十字軍使用聖十字審判時，必須極度謹慎。人類的身體太脆弱，無法完全承受上帝的意志。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Therefore, using this skill, will cause the Crusader to suffer from damage. However, this damage can
be reduced to half with Faith.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
因此，使用這個技能會導致十字軍受到傷害。不過，通過信任技能，可以將這種傷害減少一半。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
In practicing what we preach, Crusaders choose to protect
others by bearing the suffering of their fellow man.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
為了踐行我們的教義，十字軍選擇通過承受同胞的痛苦來保護他人。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
The Sacrifice skill allows Crusaders to keep their comrades safe from harm by receiving the damage that was intended for them.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
犧牲技能允許十字軍承受原本指向同伴的傷害，從而保護他們的安全。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It is the greatest demonstration of faith,
as well as of love for your comrades. Such an attitude is essential for a servant of God!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
這是信仰的最偉大體現，也是對同伴之愛的證明。這種態度對於上帝的僕人來說是必不可少的！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, if the people you want to protect stray away from you, you cannot use the Sacrifice skill for them unless they are close to you again.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不過，如果你想保護的人離你太遠，你就無法對他們使用犧牲技能，除非他們再次靠近你。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As you visualize the suffering of those you want to protect, you'll never hesitate to sacrifice yourself.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
當你想像著你想保護的人所受的苦難時，你就再也不會猶豫去犧牲自己了。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Thank you, God, for granting me with the power to protect my people.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
感謝上帝賜予我保護人民的力量。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Gleipnir is the essence of Megingjard which I have been researching.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
魔法鐵鏈是我一直在研究的雷神腰帶的精髓。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It's the only binding strong enough that will allow a human to wear Megingjard around his waist.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
它是唯一足夠強韌的束縛，能讓人類將雷神腰帶系在腰間。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Although I can no longer fight, I've been studying how to create Gleipnir for years. I will be more than willing to create it for you if you can bring me...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
雖然我不能再戰鬥了，但我已經研究如何製作魔法鐵鏈多年了。如果你能給我帶來...我很樂意為你製作它。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
^0000FF4 Cat Tread^000000,
^0000FF5 Woman's Moustache^000000,
^0000FF4 Root of Stone^000000,
^0000FF3 Sputum of Bird^000000 and
^0000FF3 Sinew of Bear^000000.

[Rebarev Doug]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Why are you wandering
around this sacred place?
Do you not understand that
we must prepare for
the Holy War?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你為什麼在這神聖之地遊蕩？
難道你不知道我們必須為聖戰做準備嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
No matter how much I explain, the ignorant never fully understand the importance of our task. The balance of power will shift when we least expect it!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
無論我如何解釋，無知的人永遠無法完全理解我們任務的重要性。當力量平衡發生轉變時，往往是在我們最意想不到的時候！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wish I could go back
to those times when I would
train Crusaders, rather than
preach to the ignorant.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我真希望能回到過去，那時我訓練十字軍，而不是向無知的人佈道。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I miss my Crusaders who
were enthusiastic to listen to what I had to say, and carried out their orders with loyalty.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我懷念我的十字軍們，他們曾熱情地聆聽我的教誨，並忠誠地執行命令。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I am wonder
where they have
all gone now...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我想知道他們現在都去了哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Adventurer, if you have the time to listen to me speak to myself, why don't you perform a task for me?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
冒險者，既然你有時間聽我自說自話，何不為我做一件事呢？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It may be an enriching
experience for you. It's possible that you'll even have a greater appreciation for Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
這對你來說可能是一次有益的經歷。你甚至可能會更加理解十字軍。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？

scripts.text: I'm sick and tired of doin' favors.
scripts.translation: 我受夠了幫這種忙

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I want you to find the members of the 1st Squad in the 3rd Platoon of the 3rd Company. If you happen to encounter them in your travels, please ask them how they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我要你找到第三連第三排第一小隊的成員。如果你在旅途中遇到他們，請詢問他們的近況。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It shouldn't be that difficult to do and won't be a waste of your time if you are already planning
to explore the world.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
這並不難，如果你本來就打算探索世界，這也不會浪費你的時間。

scripts.text: Sure, why not.
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but no.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，不行

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Excellent!
All I want you to do is find my old comrades, and inform me of how
they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
太好了！
我只需要你找到我的老戰友，並告訴我他們的近況。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However...
There is one problem.
I don't where they are.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
但是...
有一個問題。
我不知道他們在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
You could try to find a record of residency changes by citizens of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom in
the Prontera Library...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你可以嘗試在普隆德拉圖書館查詢盧恩·米德加茲王國市民的居住變動記錄...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, the records of
Crusader personnel is considered confidential, so I am not sure of whether or not you can view them.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不過，十字軍的人員記錄被視為機密，我不確定你是否能查閱到。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
You must understand, my position requires me to remain in this area 24 hours, 7 days a week. I cannot leave without the consent of the upper hierarchy.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你必須理解，我的職位要求我每週七天、每天24小時都留在這個區域。沒有上級許可，我不能離開。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, I know you have the freedom and the time to go wherever you please. I'd appreciate if you would do this for me.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
但是，我知道你有自由和時間去任何你想去的地方。如果你能幫我做這件事，我將不勝感激。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
My old comrades in arms.
You have no idea how much
I miss them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我昔日的戰友。
我真不知道有多想念他們...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Please understand that
I would not be asking this
of you if it were not for
the restraints of
my position.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
^333333*嘆息...*^000000
請理解，若非受限於我的職位，我絕不會提出這樣的請求。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I have an obligation to this Kingdom to keep my post and
inform adventurers about the
Crusader class. Because of this
awesome responsibility, I must
remain here, ever vigilant.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我有義務效忠王國，堅守崗位，並向冒險者介紹十字軍職業。
正因為這份沉重的責任，我必須留在這裡，時刻警惕。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If you can't understand, then you must be taking your freedom for granted...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果你無法理解，那你一定是把自由視為理所當然...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As far as I remember, this is the first time I have asked you to do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
據我所知，這是我第一次請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Unlike you, I know the meaning
of responsibility. I remain here, helping inquisitive adventurers for the sake of King and country.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不像你，我深知責任的意義。
我留在這裡，為了國王和國家，幫助那些好奇的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Still...
Know this.
Although the results may not be immediate, you will always be rewarded when you help others.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不過...
請記住。
雖然回報可能不會立刻顯現，但當你幫助他人時，終將得到回報。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Please reconsider
when you get the chance.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
請你在有機會時重新考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wonder how my old
comrades are doing now.
I can't even remember
the last time I saw them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不知道我昔日的戰友現在過得如何。
我甚至記不清上次見到他們是什麼時候了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Hmm...?
Haven't you left
to search for them yet?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...？
你還沒出發去找他們嗎？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我該去哪裡？

scripts.text: I am about to leave.
scripts.translation: 我正準備出發

scripts.text: What do you mean by final mission?
scripts.translation: 你說的最後任務是指什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Well...
You should be able
find some clue as to
where to find them through
^0000FFThe Platoon Records^000000 in
the Prontera Library.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...
你應該能在普隆德拉圖書館的^0000FF《第三排記錄》^000000中找到一些關於他們下落的線索。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh, you are...
I wonder what they
have been doing since
our ^0000FFfinal mission^000000...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，原來是你...
真不知道自那次^0000FF最後任務^000000以來，他們都在做些什麼...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Final mission...?
Well, I can't recall
everything at the moment,
but it was the reason why
our squad broke up.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
最後任務...？
嗯，我現在記不清所有細節了，但那是我們小隊解散的原因。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
We were a great team.
But in the military system,
you need to follow the orders
of your superiors...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我們曾是一支優秀的隊伍。
但在軍隊體制中，你必須服從上級的命令...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If only...
^660000He^000000 hadn't interfered...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
要是...
^660000他^000000沒有插手就好了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
...
......

[Rebarev Doug]
Let's not talk about that. What's important that our squad was disbanded because of we failed our final mission. Now, will you please go find ^0000FFThe 3rd Platoon Records^000000 in the Prontera Library for me?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
別談那個了。重要的是，我們小隊因為未能完成最後任務而解散了。現在，請幫我去普隆德拉圖書館找一下^0000FF《第三排記錄》^000000好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Remember, it might be helpful to ask the librarian for the file with a record on ^660000the 1st squad's final mission^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
記住，詢問圖書管理員關於^660000第一小隊最後任務^000000的記錄可能會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wonder how my old
comrades are doing now.
I can't even remember
the last time I saw them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不知道我昔日的戰友現在過得如何。
我甚至記不清上次見到他們是什麼時候了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Hmm...?
Haven't you left
to search for them yet?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...？
你還沒出發去找他們嗎？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我該去哪裡？

scripts.text: I am about to leave.
scripts.translation: 我正準備出發

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Well...
You should be able
find some clue as to
where to find them through
^0000FFThe 3rd Platoon Records^000000 in
the Prontera Library.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...
你應該能在普隆德拉圖書館的^0000FF第三排記錄^000000中找到一些關於他們下落的線索。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh, you are...
I wonder what they
have been doing since
our ^0000FFfinal mission^000000...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，原來是你...
真不知道自那次^0000FF最後任務^000000以來，他們都在做些什麼...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Huh...?
The librarian
didn't let you
read the records?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
咦...？
圖書管理員不讓你查閱記錄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
He may have responsibility,
but at the end of the day, he's just like you and me. You can find some way to convince him to help you, I'm sure.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
他雖然身負重任，但說到底，他和你我一樣都是普通人。
我相信你一定能找到辦法說服他幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Please, I beg you,
would you find out
what happened to the
rest of the 1st Squad?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
拜託了，求求你，請查明第一小隊其餘成員發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh...
It might be helpful to know that we were the ^660000Crusader Third Company, Third Platoon, First Squad^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦...
知道這一點可能會有幫助：我們是^660000十字軍第三連第三排第一小隊^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh...
So did you meet them?
Are they all okay?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦...
那你見到他們了嗎？
大家都還好嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Rebarev Doug
that although they are
suffering from migraines
and memory loss, the rest
of the 1st Squad is fine.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你告訴雷巴列夫·道格，雖然他們正遭受偏頭痛和失憶症的折磨，但第一小隊的其他成員都還安好。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Rebarev Doug
that you have read the
3rd Platoon records and
explain what you have
managed to learn.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你告訴雷巴列夫·道格，你已經查閱了第三排的記錄，並解釋了你所瞭解到的情況。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh, I'm glad to hear that
you were able to read the
records! But I don't trust
what's written on paper.
After all, it may be
out of date...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，很高興聽到你成功查閱了記錄！
但我並不完全相信紙上寫的內容。
畢竟，那些資料可能已經過時了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If it's possible, I hope you can meet the rest of the 1st Squad face to face, so I can know for sure that they're all alright.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果可能的話，我希望你能與第一小隊其餘成員見面，這樣我就能確信他們都安然無恙。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
A man's life is too
short and his friends
are too few. Please find
out how my old comrades
are doing for me.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
人生苦短，摯友難求。
請替我查明我昔日戰友的近況。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Welcome back~
It's been a while since I've last seen you. Have you met the rest
of the 1st Squad?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
歡迎回來~
好久沒見你了。你見到第一小隊其餘成員了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Hm...?
What's that
strange look for?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...？
你那是什麼奇怪的眼神？

scripts.text: Confront Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 質問雷巴列夫·道格

scripts.text: Act unsuspicious.
scripts.translation: 裝作若無其事

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou confront Rebarev Doug about the memory problems and migraines of the 1st Squad...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你質問雷巴列夫·道格關於第一小隊記憶問題和偏頭痛的事...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThinking about Royal Myst's story and the mentions of Egnigem begin to jumble your thoughts...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF想到皇家迷霧的故事和艾格尼格姆的提及，你的思緒開始變得混亂...^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
What are you talking about? I don't understand, you're talking about lots of different things at once!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你在說什麼？我不明白，你一下子說了好多不同的事情！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Don't look at me like that. If you're done speaking, please
excuse me and tell me your news some other time.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
別那樣看著我。如果你說完了，請原諒我，改天再告訴我你的訊息吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I appreciate that you've delivered news of my old comrades to me.
Now, I need to continue my research under the command of his Majesty.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
很感激你將昔日戰友的訊息帶給我。
現在，我需要在陛下麾下繼續我的研究。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou keep your suspicions to yourself and tell Rebarev Doug about the members of
the 1st Squad.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你壓下自己的疑慮，向雷巴列夫·道格講述了第一小隊成員的近況。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFOf course, you withhold some details and only tell him what he seems to want to hear.^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF當然，你隱瞞了一些細節，只告訴他那些他似乎想聽的內容。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Great!
I'm glad to hear
they're doing so well!
Ha ha! Hahahahahahaahah!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
太好了！
聽到他們過得這麼好，我真高興！
哈哈！哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I appreciate that you've delivered news of my old comrades to me.
Now, I need to continue my research under the command of his Majesty. Once again, thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
很感激你將昔日戰友的訊息帶給我。
現在，我需要在陛下麾下繼續我的研究。再次感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou confront
Rebarev Doug with the
information you learned
from Egnigem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你質問雷巴列夫·道格，拿出了從艾格尼格姆那裡得知的情報。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, he didn't
seem the least bit agitated. In fact, he exuded a calmness that makes you feel nervous.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF然而，他看起來一點也不激動。
事實上，他散發出的那種平靜讓你感到不安。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It's far too late to talk about that, though I feel sorry for you for knowing too much. At this point, there's nothing you can prove.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
現在再談那些已經太遲了，雖然你知道得太多，我為你感到遺憾。但到了這一步，你什麼都證明不了。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Don't you get it?
The elite and powerful rule this world. I am untouchable! And the weak and the lowly can rot in hell! Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你不明白嗎？
這個世界的統治者是精英和強者。我是不可觸碰的！而弱者和卑微者就該在地獄裡腐爛！嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Do you hate me?
Do you really hate me?
Take a look at this face.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你恨我嗎？
你真的恨我嗎？
看看這張臉。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
This is the
face of authority!
Go ahead and report me to the judge in charge of all military crimes! He's right behind me!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
這就是權力的臉！
儘管去告訴負責所有軍事罪行的法官吧！他就在我身後！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If at least 100 people report the same crime, then maybe he'll hold
a trial. But do you really want to reveal this to the public?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果至少有100人舉報同樣的罪行，也許他會舉行審判。但你真的想把這件事公之於眾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I didn't think
you'd actually do it.
But you'll be sorry later...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我沒想到你真的會這麼做。
但你以後會後悔的...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Don't you get it?
The elite and powerful rule this world. I am untouchable! And the weak and the lowly can rot in hell! Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你不明白嗎？
這個世界的統治者是精英和強者。我是不可觸碰的！而弱者和卑微者就該在地獄裡腐爛！嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
You're not fit
to even speak to me.
Even if you are an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你甚至不配跟我說話。
即使你是個冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
We are Crusaders that have
been training in preparation
for the Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我們是十字軍，一直在為即將到來的聖戰進行訓練。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As our forefathers have
done a thousand years ago, we shall vanquish the hordes of Demons when the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
正如我們的先輩在一千年前所做的那樣，當那一天到來時，我們將殲滅惡魔大軍。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Welcome, friend!
Here in the Prontera Castle, we Crusaders are busily preparing for the Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[馬克斯·馮·謝多]
歡迎，朋友！
在普隆德拉王宮，我們十字軍正忙著為即將到來的聖戰做準備。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Let me introduce myself.
My name is Max Von Shedough, the military judge! Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation:
[馬克斯·馮·謝多]
讓我自我介紹一下。
我是馬克斯·馮·謝多，軍事法官！你有什麼事找我嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou handed
Max Von Shedough
your petition against
Rebarev Doug based on
your investigation
with Egnigem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將基於與艾格尼格姆調查所得的針對雷巴列夫·道格的請願書交給了馬克斯·馮·謝多。^000000

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Hm? This is serious.
Alright, I will investigate your claim to the best of my ability.
scripts.translation:
[馬克斯·馮·謝多]
嗯？這很嚴重。
好吧，我會盡我所能調查你的指控。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
However, as of now, the petition you've just given me is considered classified information. Please keep this a military secret.
scripts.translation:
[馬克斯·馮·謝多]
不過，目前你剛交給我的這份請願書被視為機密資訊。請保守這個軍事秘密。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Unfortunately, I'm not sure if it's possible to hold a trial against Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation:
[馬克斯·馮·謝多]
不幸的是，我不確定是否有可能對雷巴列夫·道格進行審判。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Regrettably, it seems that he still has too much influence. Still, let me assure you that I'll do everything I can...
scripts.translation:
[馬克斯·馮·謝多]
遺憾的是，他似乎仍然擁有太大的影響力。不過，請相信我，我會盡我所能...

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
But count on me,
I'll be doing my
best to get him indicted.
scripts.translation:
[馬克斯·馮·謝多]
但請放心，我會盡我所能讓他被起訴。

Welcome, friend!

scripts.translation:

歡迎，朋友！
在普隆德拉王宮，我們十字軍正忙著為即將到來的聖戰做準備。

讓我自我介紹一下。
我是馬克斯·馮·謝多，軍事法官！遺憾的是，就連我們十字軍也無法完全避免腐敗...

is off limits!
scripts.translation:

等...等一下！
那個區域禁止進入！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah, please do
not touch the files
in this section.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
啊，請不要觸碰這個區域的檔案。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Some of the information
here is classified, and it is therefore prohibited by the Prontera Military to browse
through them.

這裡的一些資訊是機密的，因此普隆德拉軍方禁止瀏覽這些檔案。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'm currently in the process of searching for the classified files in that section, so that I can separate it from the information that is public domain.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我目前正在查詢該區域的機密檔案，以便將其與公開資訊分開。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'd highly
appreciate it
if you ^660000didn't^000000
interfere with my work.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
如果你^660000不^000000妨礙我的工作，我會非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Darn it...!
I can't read anything when the light is this dim! It's bad enough my eyes have gone bad...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
該死...！
光線這麼暗，我什麼都看不清！我的視力本來就不好了...

scripts.text: You have bad eyes?
scripts.translation: 你的視力不好嗎？

scripts.text: I want to read some documents.
scripts.translation: 我想讀一些檔案

scripts.text: Let me help you find those files...
scripts.translation: 讓我幫你找那些檔案...

scripts.text: What kind of files are you looking for?
scripts.translation: 你在找什麼樣的檔案？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I've worked
under dim light
for so long, my eyes have
gone bad. They should get me ^0000FFa new light^000000, otherwise I'll go blind sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我在昏暗的光線下工作太久了，視力變差了。他們應該給我^0000FF一盞新燈^000000，否則我遲早會失明的...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hey, that's some pretty useful stuff that you've got with you. Do you mind letting me borrow it for a while? It'll help me in finding those files...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嘿，你身上帶著一些很有用的東西。介意借給我用一會兒嗎？這會幫我找到那些檔案...

scripts.text: Yes, I mind!
scripts.translation: 是的，我介意！

scripts.text: No, I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 不，我不介意

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
^333333*Sniff*^000000
N-never mind...

[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, you are so kind!
Y-you really do want
to help me, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
你真是太好了！
你...你真的願意幫我，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Thank you...
Now I won't have to
worry so much about
finding that file.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
謝謝你...
這樣我就不必那麼擔心找不到那份檔案了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
If it's alright,
would you help me
look for it...?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
如果不介意的話，你能幫我找找嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Thank you...
The stuff you let
me borrow will really
help me in looking for
all of those files...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
謝謝你...
你借給我的東西真的能幫我找到那些檔案...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Read some documents?
Well, you've come here
to the Library. That's
a good start.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
閱讀一些檔案？
既然你來到了圖書館，那就是個好的開始。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Well, as long as
you know what kind
of document you're
looking for, you might
be able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯，只要你清楚你在找什麼樣的檔案，也許就能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekin]
I've got to find that
classified file as soon
as I can!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我必須儘快找到那份機密檔案！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm...?
Hey, haven't
I told you already?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯...？
嘿，我不是已經告訴過你了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
The public is prohibited from browsing the files in this section! How many times do I need to repeat myself?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
公眾禁止瀏覽此區域的檔案！我要重複多少遍才行？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'd gladly accept your
help if it weren't for the fact that I cannot allow classified information to be released to the public.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我很樂意接受你的幫助，但我不能允許機密資訊洩露給公眾。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I have no idea how something so important was shuffled into the files here in Prontera Library, but we can't allow the public to access it.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我不知道這麼重要的東西怎麼會混進普隆德拉圖書館的檔案裡，但我們不能允許公眾接觸它。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Still, that file doesn't seem to be that important, but I still have to waste my time on finding it...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
不過，那份檔案似乎也沒那麼重要，但我還是得浪費時間去尋找它...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Damn, my eyes are sore.
Working as a government official is easy except for the times when the beaucrats make you do stuff like this.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
該死，我的眼睛好痛。
當公務員很容易，除了那些官僚讓你做這種事的時刻。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I think I'm going to go
insane looking for this file...!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
找這份檔案，我覺得我快要瘋了...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Huh...?
Did you just say
that you wanted to
help me? I-I'd appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
咦...？
你剛才說想幫我？
我...我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Um, you're not even
supposed to know what
kind of file I'm looking for. Even if you did, I'm not allowed to show you what's inside!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯，你甚至不應該知道我在找什麼樣的檔案。即使你知道，我也不允許給你看裡面的內容！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm. I'm not really allowed to disclose any information related to that file. I'm sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯。我不被允許透露任何與那份檔案相關的資訊。
很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But isn't
the file about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但那份檔案是不是關於...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm...?
How did you
know about that?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯...？
你是怎麼知道那件事的？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Errmmm...
I don't think so....?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
呃...
我不覺得是那樣...？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah, please do not touch the files in this section. Usually, it's public domain but it seems that a classified file managed to get misplaced there.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
啊，請不要觸碰這一區的檔案。
通常這裡是公開區域，但似乎有一份機密檔案被誤放到了那裡。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For now, I cannot let anyone without special authorization to look through that section. I must find that file and send it to the Prontera military as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
目前，我不能讓沒有特別授權的人檢視那一區。
我必須儘快找到那份檔案，並把它送到普隆德拉的軍隊那裡。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ergh! This light isn't bright enough for my eyes. They're starting to get sore again...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
唉！這燈光對我的眼睛來說不夠亮。
它們又開始痠痛了...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
So what brings you here? If you're looking for something in particular, you should try another section.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
那麼，是什麼把你帶到這裡來的？
如果你在找特定的東西，你應該去其他區域試試。

scripts.text: I want to read some documents.
scripts.translation: 我想讀一些檔案

scripts.text: Do you have bad eyes?
scripts.translation: 你的眼睛不好嗎？

scripts.text: Let me help you to find the files.
scripts.translation: 讓我幫你找檔案

scripts.text: What kind of files are you looking for?
scripts.translation: 你在找什麼樣的檔案？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I told you already! The files in this section aren't open to the public right now! Don't make me repeat myself!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我已經說過了！
這一區的檔案目前不對公眾開放！
別讓我再說第二遍！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Since I have worked under a dim light for a long time, my eyes have gone bad.
They should get me a new light, otherwise I will be gone blind sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
因為我在昏暗的燈光下工作了很久，我的視力變差了。
他們應該給我換一盞新燈，否則我遲早會失明的...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Um? How do you know what file I am looking for?
You don't even know what is written inside?
Stop interrupting me, leave!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯？你怎麼知道我在找什麼檔案？
你甚至不知道里面寫了什麼？
別打斷我，走開！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm... I am not supposed to reveal anything related to the file.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯...我不被允許透露任何與那份檔案相關的資訊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't the file...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那份檔案是不是關於...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Maybe...
Maybe not~
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
也許吧...
也許不是~

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm? So did you find it? I've been searching for that file for a long time, but I haven't been able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯？所以你找到了嗎？
我找那份檔案找了好久，但一直沒能找到。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll go ahead and search the right side, so do you think you could search the left?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我先去右邊找找，你能去左邊找找嗎？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Did you find it yet? All this time, and I still haven't been able to dig up that file.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
你找到了嗎？
這麼久了，我還沒能挖出那份檔案。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll go ahead and check the left side, so would you look for it in the middle or the right side?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我先去左邊查查，你能在中間或右邊找找嗎？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah! There it is!
Thank you so much!
I'm glad to see that there are still kind and thoughtful people like you in the world.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
啊！就是那個！
非常感謝！
很高興看到世界上還有像你這樣善良體貼的人。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I really want to give you something to show you my gratitude, but I've got to send this back to the Prontera Military right away.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我很想送您點什麼以表謝意，但我必須立刻把這份檔案送回普隆德拉軍隊。

scripts.text: I want to read the document.
scripts.translation: 我想閱讀這份檔案

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, right, you mentioned that, didn't you? It doesn't seem seem
so important, but I'm not really quite sure...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
哦，對，您之前提到過這件事，是嗎？
看起來似乎沒那麼重要，但我也不太確定...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Well, it couldn't hurt if I made a copy of this first for you to read, but I'll need some materials.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯，先為您複製一份也無妨，但我需要一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll even cast the
Search Magic on it, so that it'll be just like the original. All right, I need the following things to make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
我還會對它施放搜尋魔法，讓副本和原件一模一樣。
好的，製作副本需要以下物品...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
2 Slick Paper,
1 Oil Paper,
3 Squid Ink,
3 Feather of Birds and
20 Blue Gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
2張光滑的紙、1張油紙、3個墨汁、3個鳥羽和20個藍色魔力礦石。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Please get those as soon as possible, and I'll be here making the other preparations to make a copy.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
請儘快去準備這些材料，我會在這裡做其他複製準備工作。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Also, I'll keep this copy in the Library for you to read, and to prevent it from being leaked to the public. So you'll have to come visit each time you wish to read it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
另外，我會把這份副本留在圖書館供您閱讀，並防止它洩露給公眾。
所以每次想讀的時候，您都得過來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Okay, now...
Come back here
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
好了，現在...
請儘快回來。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, you came back.
I didn't expect you to return here so quickly. Whatever's inside must be really important for you to know.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
哦，您回來了。
沒想到您這麼快就回來了。
看來裡面的內容對您來說真的很重要。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Anyway, please
give me a moment
while I make that
copy for you.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
總之，請給我一點時間，我來為您製作副本。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Alright then...
I'll see you in a bit.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
那麼...
我稍後見。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Have you forgotten
what you need to make
a copy? Alright, let me
tell you again...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
您忘了製作副本需要什麼了嗎？
好吧，讓我再告訴您一遍...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
2 Slick Paper,
1 Oil Paper,
3 Squid Ink,
3 Feather of Birds and
20 Blue Gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
2張光滑的紙、1張油紙、3個墨汁、3個鳥羽和20個藍色魔力礦石。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Please come
back with those items
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
請儘快帶著那些物品回來。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Let me go over and review the document before I make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
讓我先過去檢視一下檔案，然後再製作副本...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Let me go over and review the document before I make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
讓我先過去檢視一下檔案，然後再製作副本...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
There you go. As I thought, the document didn't seem to contain any crucially important data.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
好了。正如我所料，這份檔案似乎不包含任何至關重要的資料。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Just remember, this copy needs to stay in the Prontera Library. That means you have to come back if you need to read the document again.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
請記住，這份副本必須留在普隆德拉圖書館。
這意味著如果您需要再次閱讀檔案，必須回來。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Welcome, my friend!
So, what do you need today?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
歡迎，我的朋友！
那麼，您今天需要什麼？

scripts.translation:
^663300[關鍵詞: ^996633第3排^663300]

[Librarian Jekan]
Well...
This is a pretty
obsolete version
of Search Magic,
so I understand if
it's giving you trouble.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
嗯...
這是相當過時的搜尋魔法版本，所以如果它讓你感到困擾，我完全理解。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Now...
First, if you're going to enter a single search term, like someone's name, you would enter '^660000lee_hester^000000' if you were looking up 'Lee Hester.'
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
那麼...
首先，如果你要輸入單個搜尋詞，比如某個人的名字，如果你要找“李·海絲特”，你應該輸入'^660000lee_hester^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Don't use any
capital letters!
And use underscores to
indicate spaces between first and last names and within military unit names.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
不要使用任何大寫字母！
並且使用下劃線來表示名字中名與姓之間以及軍事單位名稱中的空格。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For example, the Fourth Company would be entered as ^6600004th_company^000000. Now... bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
例如，第四連應該輸入為^6600004th_company^000000。
那麼...請耐心聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
If you're looking for information on a specific squad, you need to know the Platoon and Company it falls under.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
如果你在尋找特定小隊的資訊，你需要知道它所屬的排和連。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For example, if you wanted to look up the Crusader 4th Squad of the 4th Platoon of the 4th Company, you would input...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
例如，如果你想查詢第四連第四排第四小隊的十字軍，你應該輸入...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
'^660000crusader 4th_company 4th_platoon 4th_squad record^000000' all in one line exactly like that. I hope this helps you in your search...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
'^660000crusader 4th_company 4th_platoon 4th_squad record^000000'
全部在一行內，就像那樣。希望這能幫助你搜索...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
You can tell our
government doesn't
really know how to
allocate its funds
and resources.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
你可以看出，我們的政府並不真正知道如何分配資金和資源。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
First, there's Jawaii.
Do newlyweds really need
an entire island for themselves? Then again, I am single so I'm probably biased.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
首先，有爪哇。
新婚夫婦真的需要一整個島嶼作為他們的專屬地嗎？
不過話說回來，我是單身，所以我可能有偏見。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
And look at me.
Geniuses aren't supposed to waste their precious time doing useless things for libraries!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
再看看我。
天才不應該浪費寶貴的時間為圖書館做無用的事情！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah, please do not touch any books in that section. ...I'm sure there's nothing there that could be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員 傑坎]
啊，請不要觸碰那個區域的任何書籍。
...我確信那裡沒有任何對你有用的東西。

scripts.text: Ignore him and check books.

scripts.text: Step back.

free to browse through

Any military force or party needs their supplies to be replenished if they are to continue battling for a prolonged period of time.

scripts.translation:
[贊·華獨]
例如，假設你的隊伍在沒有治療者的情況下進行狩獵。在這種情況下，每個人都會消耗恢復HP的物品，比如藥水。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]

scripts.translation:
[贊·華獨]

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
But if one of your party members traveled between town and the hunting area, he could supply your party with new healing items.
scripts.translation:
[贊·華獨]

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]

哦，我還有個小小的秘密...！我聽說旅店老闆正在策劃某種見不得人的生意。那是個很大的專案，但別告訴任何人是我告訴你的！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wh-who are you?!
How the hell did
you get in here?!
Get away from me!
Geeeet awwwway!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
你...你是誰？！
你他媽是怎麼進來的？！
離我遠點！
快...快滾開！

快...快滾開！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou try your best to calm him down and to tell him what you've found in the document.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你盡力安撫他，並告訴他你在檔案中發現了什麼。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pulled out a {0}
to cover your face, and wiggled its arms as if it were talking.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿出一個{0}遮住臉，並揮動它的手臂，彷彿在說話一樣。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou must find something
that can calm Cuaque Donon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你必須找到能讓夸克·多農平靜下來的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSadly, Chaque Donon seems
to have regressed to a very childish mentality. Perhaps if you brought something that children like. Something that would offer them comfort...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF遺憾的是，夸克·多農似乎退化到了非常幼稚的狀態。也許如果你帶些孩子們喜歡的東西來，能讓他們感到安心...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFChaque Donon nodded his head
and happily sucked his thumb. It saddens you to see a former Crusader reduced to this state.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF夸克·多農點了點頭，開心地吮吸著大拇指。看到曾經的十字軍淪落到這種地步，讓你感到十分難過。^000000

scripts.text: Ask him about the Inn Maid.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於旅店女僕的事

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 詢問他最近過得怎麼樣

scripts.text: Ask about 1st Squad's Final Mission.
scripts.translation: 詢問第一小隊的最終任務

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
S-she's my sister.
And she's also a Rogue.
When I was retired from service....
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
她...她是我妹妹。
她也是個流氓。
在我退役的時候...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
...
......

[Cuaque Donon]
My family always expected
too much of me. That's why I used to be a Crusader. I mean, they're paid well and respected.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
我的家人總是對我期望過高。所以我才去當十字軍。畢竟，那份工作薪水高，而且受人尊敬。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
When I retired, my sister was so mad. She's the only one I can depend upon, but now that I've messed up my life like this...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
我退役後，妹妹非常生氣。她是我唯一可以依靠的人，但現在我把生活搞得一團糟...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
But even after yelling at me, and saying I was worthless, she got 
me a job at her Inn anyway.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
但即使她罵了我，說我一無是處，最後還是給我安排了在她旅店的工作。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I've been working there,
living a quiet life. But now, for some reason, a lot of people want to talk to me about something important.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
我在那裡工作，過著平靜的生活。但現在，不知為何，很多人想找我談一些重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I don't know what I said or did, but I think when I gave them the right answer, after I could finally remember something, they tried to hurt me.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
我不知道自己說了什麼或做了什麼，但我覺得當我終於想起一些事情並給出正確答案時，他們試圖傷害我。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
So now my sister's been hiding
me here. It's boring and lonely, and the guy downstairs is always yelling at me to leave.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
所以現在妹妹把我藏在這裡。這裡很無聊也很孤獨，樓下的那個傢伙總是衝我大喊讓我離開。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Even the Rogue Guild that
my sister's a part of comes in sometimes to yell at me. They all want me to tell them something I'm supposed to know!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
甚至妹妹所在的流氓公會的人有時也會進來衝我大喊。他們都想讓我說出一些我本該知道的事情！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
But I can't remember anything!
This place is safe from dangerous people, but I don't know for how long.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
但我什麼都記不起來！這個地方雖然能避開危險的人，但不知道能維持多久。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Even my sister says I have to tell the Rogue Guild what I should know, or they won't protect us anymore.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
連妹妹也說我必須告訴流氓公會我本該知道的事，否則他們就不會再保護我們了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
She looked really sad when she
said that. I don't want to let her down or make her upset. She's
all I have left...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
她說這話時看起來很傷心。我不想讓她失望或難過。她是我剩下的唯一親人了...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Oh, I do remember something!
My sister told me not to tell anyone, but I'm gonna tell you...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
哦，我記得一件事！
妹妹告訴我不要告訴任何人，但我打算告訴你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFCuaque Donon
whispers into your ears.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF夸克·多農在你耳邊低語。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
^666666She said the Rogue Guild wants something from me. So she's gonna send to me to good people that we can trust and can help me.^000000
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
^666666她說流氓公會想要從我這裡得到些什麼。所以她打算派一些我們可以信任、能幫上忙的好人來找我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
^666666Still, this is the safest place for me for a while. But I'm always ready to run away if I have to.^000000
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
^666666不過，這裡目前對我來說是最安全的地方。但如果有必要，我隨時準備逃跑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
How have I been doing?
Lots of people have been coming
to see me. They all want me to tell them something I don't even know!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
我最近過得怎麼樣？
很多人來看我。他們都想讓我告訴他們一些我甚至都不知道的事情！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
The Rogue Guild promised to
protect me, but they scare the hell out of me sometimes by coming out of the floor all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
流氓公會承諾會保護我，但他們有時突然從地板下鑽出來，真的把我嚇壞了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Oh, and my sister said she's
gonna complain to my old boss about something. She said I used to be fine, but now that I've retired, I'm not the same anymore.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
哦，還有，我妹妹說她要去向我的前老闆投訴些什麼。她說我以前沒事，但現在退休了，就不一樣了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
But my old boss from when I was a Crusader doesn't wanna meet my sister. So she's gonna ask help from other Rogues to spread some rumors...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
但我當十字軍時的前老闆不想見我妹妹。所以她打算找其他流氓幫忙散佈一些謠言...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Like anyone who works as a Crusader under my old boss will end up like me. You know... broken.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
比如，任何在我前老闆手下當十字軍的人最後都會像我一樣。你知道的...變得不正常。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I don't know...
I can't even remember.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
我不知道...
我甚至記不清了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wait, that's right!
^0000FFMegingjard^000000! Right.
We found it, and
we knew what it was
just by looking at it!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
等等，對了！
^0000FF雷神腰帶^000000！沒錯。
我們找到了它，光看就知道它是什麼了！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Megingjard^000000!
^FFFFFFListen to him quietly^000000.
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFF靜靜地聽他說^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Waaaaaaaah~!
You're the same
as all the others!
Go away from me!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
哇啊啊啊~！
你們和其他人一樣！
離我遠點！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I remember after we found it. One of us in the squad had a argument with our old leader. I was keeping night watch and happened to hear it. I think our leader was out of line...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
我記得找到它之後。小隊裡有人和我們的前首領發生了爭執。我當時在守夜，碰巧聽到了。我覺得我們的首領做得有點過分...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Ergh...
I can't remember
more than that...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
呃...
我記不清更多了...

[Cuaque Donon]
I'm getting sleepy
and my head hurts.
Let me rest now...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
我困了，頭也很痛。
讓我休息一下...

How the hell did
you get in here?!
Get away from me!
Geeeet awwwway!

How the hell did
you get in here?!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
你...你是誰？！
你怎麼進來的？！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wahhhhh...!
My head!
It's hurting so bad!
I'm so s-scared!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多農]
哇啊啊啊...！
我的頭！
好痛！
我好...好害怕！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安靜又無聊。看看今天有沒有什麼值得招募的劍士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Eh...?
Ask him about Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於雷巴列夫·道格的事

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 詢問他最近過得怎麼樣

scripts.text: Ask him about the last mission of the 1st Squad.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於第一小隊最後一次任務的事

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah! Yeah, our old leader back in the 1st Squad. Heh. I haven't seen him since we were disbanded.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
啊！對，第一小隊以前的首領。呵。自從我們解散後，我就沒見過他了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Me? Yeah, I'm always busy recruiting future Crusaders.
We always welcome Swordmen
of great ability!
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
我？對，我一直忙著招募未來的十字軍。
我們永遠歡迎能力出眾的劍士！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
How does it sound? Why don't you volunteer to become a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
聽起來怎麼樣？何不志願成為十字軍的一員呢？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Last mission?
Eh, I don't really remember it.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
最後一次任務？
呃，我不太記得了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000

Eh...?
Ask him about Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於雷巴列夫·道格的事

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 詢問他最近過得怎麼樣

scripts.text: Ask about 1st Squad's final mission.
scripts.translation: 詢問第一小隊最後一次任務的事

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah right. Our old leader.
Now I remember: He was
a pretty self righteous jerk
now that I think about it!
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
啊對。我們的老首領。
現在我想起來了：仔細想想，他其實是個相當自大的混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Can you believe he used to say that ^0000FFno one is more religious than him in this world^000000?! That's egoism right there. And maybe insanity.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
你能相信嗎？他以前常說^0000FF這世上沒有人比他更虔誠^000000？！這就是自戀。也許還有點瘋。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, everyone in the squad
took pride in their faith. When
you're having a rough time in the
real world, you depend on religion, you know?
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
總之，小隊裡的每個人都以自己的信仰為榮。當你在現實世界中過得艱難時，你會依賴宗教，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyways, in the records about
our squad, it says that one of us was punished for insubordination, rebelling or something. That's
a complete lie.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
不管怎樣，關於小隊的記錄裡說，我們其中一人因違抗命令或叛亂受到了懲罰。這完全是謊言。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
During our final mission,
our old leader had a huge argument with one us over something we found. I remember it being some kind of godly artifact, but I can't clearly remember what it was.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
在最後一次任務中，我們的老首領和我們其中一人因為發現的東西發生了激烈的爭吵。我記得那是某種神聖的遺物，但我記不清具體是什麼了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Although there was an obvious dispute, I think it was our squad leader who was out of line.
I... I can't really say...
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
雖然當時有明顯的爭執，但我認為是小隊首領失態了。
我...我真的說不清...

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
I can't for the life of me
remember how the guy who
argued with the squad leader
looked like. The higher-ups
musta did something to me...
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
我拼命也想不起來那個和首領爭吵的人長什麼樣。上面的人肯定對我做了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, I know for sure that whatever that guy did, it wasn't insubordination. In fact, I think he might've been right!
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
總之，我確信那個人做的任何事都不是違抗命令。事實上，我覺得他可能是對的！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
That's all I can remember.
I better take some Green Herbs now. My head throbs like crazy whenever I think about that time.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
這就是我能記起的全部了。
我得吃點綠色藥草了。每次想起那段時光，我的頭就痛得厲害。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah! Yeah, our old leader back in the 1st Squad. Heh. I haven't seen him since we were disbanded.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
啊！對，第一小隊以前的首領。呵。自從我們解散後，我就沒見過他了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Me? Yeah, I'm not doing so bad. Keeping busy recruiting future Crusaders. We welcome all
Swordmen if they show potential~
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
我？對，我過得還不錯。忙著招募未來的十字軍。只要展現出潛力，我們歡迎所有劍士~

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
Why would
you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
哈...？
你為什麼想知道這個？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou tell him what you've read in the records for the 1st Squad. Afterwards, Jack O looks a little confused.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你告訴他你在第一小隊的記錄中讀到的內容。之後，傑克·奧看起來有些困惑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
I might not be able to remember
a whole lot from back then, but the part about ^0000FFinsubordination^000000 can't be right. I'm sure of that.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
哈...？
我可能記不清那時候的很多事了，但關於^0000FF違抗命令^000000的部分肯定不對。我對此很確定。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Our old leader was
so arrogant to the point
of being a little off his rocker.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
我們以前的首領傲慢到了有點神志不清的地步。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
I mean, normal people
don't say things like '^0000FFI am the most religious man in the universe! Kneel before me!^000000' Yeah. Not a normal thing to say.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
我是說，正常人不會說像'^0000FF我是宇宙中最虔誠的人！跪下吧！^000000'這樣的話。對。這不是正常人會說的話。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, if the squad
leader punished anyone for insubordination, I'm sure that it was unwarranted. I don't remember too much, but I'm sure of that.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
總之，如果小隊長因為違抗命令而懲罰了任何人，我確信那是毫無道理的。我記不太清了，但我對此很確定。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Excuse me, I need to take some Green Herbs. Taking these seems
to be the only thing that works for my headache.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
抱歉，我需要吃點綠色藥草。吃這個似乎是唯一能緩解我頭痛的方法。

scripts.text:
^3355FFJack O busily chewed
on some Green Herbs.
It seemed to greatly relieve him from the pain of his headaches.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF傑克·奧忙著咀嚼一些綠色藥草。
這似乎極大地緩解了他頭痛的痛苦。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000

^333333*哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安靜又無聊。看看今天有沒有什麼值得招募的劍士吧。

Ever think about
bein' a Crusader?
scripts.translation:

嘿，小傢伙！
有沒有想過成為十字軍？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Hey kid!
Ever think about
bein' a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
嘿，小傢伙！
有沒有想過成為十字軍？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Basically, you'd be volunteering to be part of our military, as well as train for the Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
基本上，你是自願加入我們的軍隊，併為聖戰進行訓練。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
If you have some faith and know how to wield a sword, you'll be more than welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
如果你有信仰，並且知道如何使用劍，這裡將非常歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Just think about my suggestion
and come back if you're interested. Alright then, see you later~
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
考慮一下我的建議，如果你感興趣的話再回來。那麼，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安靜又無聊。看看今天有沒有什麼值得招募的劍士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
Are you interested in knowing more about Crusaders? Hahaha, I guess that must be the case.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
哈...？
你對了解更多關於十字軍的事情感興趣嗎？哈哈，我想應該是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
By the way, bring a doll to
the kid in front of me. If you're lucky, she'll give you something neat in return. What it is, I don't know. I've got no dolls.
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
順便說一句，帶個娃娃給我前面的那個小孩。如果你運氣好，她會給你一些不錯的東西作為回報。是什麼，我不知道。我沒有娃娃。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
In accordance with the Crusader code, I'm not supposed to lie. So yeah, you can trust me!
scripts.translation:
[傑克·奧]
根據十字軍守則，我不應該撒謊。所以，你可以相信我！

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items!

scripts.text:

^333333*Sigh...*^000000 I haven't gotten any response from them. I don't know
if I can wait much longer to join the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000 我沒有收到他們的回覆。我不知道我還能等多久才能加入卡普拉公司。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Oh, an adventurer! I actually used to work in the same field that you do. More specifically, I used to be a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
哦，一位冒險者！我實際上以前也從事過和你一樣的工作。更具體地說，我以前是一名十字軍。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
My name is Emma Searth. Right now, I'm following my dream and applying to be a Kafra Lady. So my days of wielding a sword are over.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
我的名字是艾瑪·西爾斯。現在，我追隨我的夢想，申請成為卡普拉女士。所以我揮舞劍的日子結束了。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Sadly, I haven't succeeded yet because I was diagnosed with
some weird ^0000FFamnesia^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
不幸的是，我還沒有成功，因為我被診斷出患有奇怪的^0000FF失憶症^000000。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Of course, I understand that
Kafra Corporation is a large, professional company, but
if I can work for them even if it's just part-time...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
當然，我理解卡普拉公司是一家大型、專業的公司，但即使只是兼職，我也希望能為他們工作...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Is it that big of a problem?
I suppose they're worried
that I'd forget important customer information once I'm hired.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
這真的是個大問題嗎？
我想他們擔心我一旦入職，就會忘記重要的顧客資訊。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
It's strange. When I was
a Crusader, I remembered
everything lucidly, and I never had any problems recalling the past.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
這很奇怪。當我還是十字軍的時候，我記憶非常清晰，回憶過去從未出過任何問題。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
But now I get these migraines whenever I try to focus on my memories from those times
when I used to fight in the Prontera Military.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
但現在，每當我試圖回憶在普隆德拉軍隊服役時的記憶，就會頭痛欲裂。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
About her past.
scripts.translation: 關於她的過去

scripts.text: Why be a Kafra Lady?
scripts.translation: 為什麼想成為卡普拉女士

scripts.text: About memories she can remember.
scripts.translation: 關於她記得的記憶

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe scent of your
Memory Bookmark
seems to bring clarity
to her thoughts.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你記憶書籤的氣味似乎讓她的思緒變得清晰。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I was born in a wealthy family where I was raised to learn etiquette, fencing, Peco riding, and music lessons since I was
born. I suppose you can say I'm pretty well educated.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
我出生在一個富裕的家庭，從小就被教導禮儀、擊劍、騎乘大嘴鳥和音樂。
我想可以說我受過良好的教育。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
However, my parents weren't
pleased when they learned that I wanted to become a Kafra Lady.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
然而，當父母得知我想成為卡普拉女士時，他們並不高興。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
My parents insisted that
I become a Sage or a Scholar.
In the end, I ended up running
away from them by joining the Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
父母堅持讓我成為賢者或學者。最後，我加入了十字軍，逃離了他們。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Luckily, the Crusaders were advertising their recruitment at the time, so I took that chance. Plus, having military experience might even help me join Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
幸運的是，當時十字軍正在招募，我就抓住了這個機會。而且，有軍事經驗也許能幫我加入卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Since I did so well in Boot Camp,
I got the chance to join an elite squad. My squad was often assigned difficult missions, and we never failed to complete those.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
因為我在新兵訓練營表現出色，我獲得了加入精英小隊的機會。我們的小隊經常被分配艱難的任務，但我們從未失敗過。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Eventually, my reputation as a female Crusader, and being in a respectable military position, was enough to satisfy my family.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
最終，我作為女性十字軍的名聲，以及我在軍隊中體面的職位，足以讓家人滿意。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
But after that day,
everything went wrong.
I only remember that it
was very sad and depressing.
Somehow, I feel like we were
even betrayed...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
但在那天之後，一切都變糟了。
我只記得那天非常悲傷和壓抑。
不知為何，我覺得我們甚至被背叛了...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I think I can
try to remember
my comrades...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
我想我可以試著回憶我的同志們...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Ah, let's not talk about it. It's too depressing. Maybe if you had some sort of ^0000FFmemory^000000 aid, I might be able to recall my forgotten past. Anything, like a reminder, a scheduler, a bookmark, a string...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
啊，別談這個了。太令人沮喪了。也許如果你有一些^0000FF記憶^000000輔助工具，我可能就能回憶起被遺忘的過去。任何東西，比如提醒物、日程表、書籤、繩子...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
One day, I happened to see Ms. Leilah at work here in Al De Baran. She was shining with confidence and commanded respect, even from her customers!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
有一天，我碰巧看到萊拉女士在艾爾帕蘭這裡工作。
她自信滿滿，令人尊敬，甚至顧客們對她都充滿敬意！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
She carried herself like a professional, no matter what the situation. Even though I knew she was tired from working in the summer heat, she made everything look effortless!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
無論情況如何，她都表現得非常專業。雖然我知道她在酷暑中工作很累，但她讓一切看起來毫不費力！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
When the male customers try to flirt with her, she never loses her poise. She just adjusts her glasses and does what she needs to do.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
當男顧客試圖搭訕她時，她從不失態。她只是調整一下眼鏡，然後繼續做她需要做的事。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
To me, she's like a lone, guardian angel. At that moment, it seemed the world existed just to be mocked by Ms. Leila.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
對我來說，她就像一位孤獨的守護天使。在那一刻，彷彿整個世界都只是為了讓萊拉女士嘲笑而存在的。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I've also heard that Kafra Ladies are always traveling around the world, which is something I've always dreamed of doing.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
我還聽說，卡普拉的女士們總是周遊世界，這也是我一直夢想著要做的事。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Ms. Leilah is my idol,
and she's the reason why
I want to become a Kafra Lady.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
萊拉女士是我的偶像，也是我想成為卡普拉女士的原因。

scripts.text: ^3355FFEmma Searth clutches her head and winces as she suffers from another migraine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾瑪·西爾斯抱著頭，因又一次偏頭痛而痛苦地皺起眉頭。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFRemembering that a Green Herb was able to relieve Jack O, you gave a Green Herb to Emma. She takes it, and looks a little more relaxed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF想起綠色藥草曾讓傑克·奧緩解過疼痛，你遞給艾瑪一株綠色藥草。她接過去，神情看起來稍微放鬆了一些。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I'm not even sure
how much I can remember
and how much I've actually
forgotten.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
我甚至不確定自己還能記得多少，又有多少是真正被遺忘的。

scripts.text:

Let me...

scripts.translation:

讓我...
試著回憶一下我們小隊裡的每一個人。讓我想想，有傑克·奧，九號球。贊...贊·華獨。夸克·多農。還有我自己。嗯，艾...艾格...艾格尼...嗯...

named that with us?

天哪。我確信他可能...不，我們隊裡有叫這個名字的人嗎？

scripts.text:

^0000FFJack O, The Nineball, Zan.Huadoku, Cuaque Donon, Egnigem.^000000 Oh, I really miss those guys...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
^0000FF傑克·奧，九號球，贊·華獨，夸克·多農，艾格尼格姆。^000000 哦，我真想念那些傢伙...

scripts.translation:

^333333*嘆氣...*^000000 我沒有收到他們的回覆。我不知道我還能等多久才能加入卡普拉公司。

scripts.text:

Egnigem...
That name makes
me so sad. I'm not
quite sure why, but...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑪·西爾斯]
艾格尼格姆...
這個名字讓我感到悲傷。我不太清楚為什麼，但是...

艾格尼格姆...
這個名字讓我感到悲傷。我不太清楚為什麼，但是...

I wish I knew what that name really means. I'm sure it's linked to an important memory from my past.
scripts.translation:

我真想知道這個名字到底意味著什麼。我確信它與過去一段重要的記憶有關。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

非常感謝你來到這裡，和我聊聊過去的事。我，我想把這個給你。

[Emma Searth]
I hear the Kafra Ladies always travel around the world, something I've always dreamed of doing! Hopefully, one of these days, I'll be able to work for the Kafra Corporation too.
scripts.translation:

聽說卡普拉的女士們總是周遊世界，這也是我一直夢想著要做的事！希望有一天，我也能加入卡普拉公司工作。

scripts.text:

^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Still, it's discouraging. I haven't heard anything from them...

^333333*嘆息...*^000000
不過，這讓人很沮喪。我還沒有收到他們的任何訊息...

scripts.translation:

第一小隊？對，我以前就在裡面。我們小隊的人以前都是很好的夥伴。

scripts.text:

Zan.Huadoku, Cuaque Donon,
Jack O, Emma Searth and The Nineball. Yeah... I wonder what they're all up to?
scripts.translation:

贊·華獨、夸克·多農、傑克·奧、艾瑪·西爾斯和九號球。是啊...不知道他們現在都在忙些什麼？

scripts.text: Speak of Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 談論雷巴列夫·道格

scripts.text: Speak of the 3rd squad.
scripts.translation: 談論第三小隊

scripts.text: Talk about gambling.
scripts.translation: 談論賭博

scripts.text: Discuss hobbies.
scripts.translation: 聊聊愛好

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Huh? What's that old geezer want this time? Tell 'em I'm fine, dandy even! Why the hell does he keep sending people...
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
哈？那個老傢伙這次又想幹嘛？告訴他們我很好，簡直棒極了！他到底為什麼要一直派人來...

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
What the hell!? Stop talking about him! I never wanna see his face again! Tell him to leave me the hell alone!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
該死的！別跟我提他！我再也不想看到他的臉了！告訴他別來煩我！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Damn geezer...
How much is he being paid for studying what we all found?! Eh, somehow, I don't care as long as
he pays me...
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
該死的老傢伙...
他研究我們找到的東西能拿多少錢？呃，反正只要他付錢給我，我就無所謂...

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Yeah...
I just don't
care anymore.
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
是啊...
我現在什麼都不在乎了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
1st Squad? Yeah, I used to be in that. All of us in the squad used to be real good buddies too.
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
第一小隊？對，我以前就在裡面。我們小隊的人以前都是很好的夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Zan.Huadoku, Cuaque Donon,
Jack O, Emma Searth and The Nineball. Yeah... I wonder what they're all up to?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
贊·華獨、夸克·多農、傑克·奧、艾瑪·西爾斯和九號球。是啊...不知道他們現在都在忙些什麼？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
1st Squad?
Don't know, don't care~
Do I look like a stupid Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
第一小隊？
不知道，也不關心~
我看起來像個愚蠢的十字軍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Gambling? ! Oh man...
I love gambling, you know!
Heh, but I haven't been lucky enough to win yet. Hahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
賭博？！天哪...
你知道的，我超愛賭博！嘿，但我還沒幸運到能贏錢。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Gambling...!
Heh heh! Some risks you take,
and others you really shouldn't.
I can't help but feel sorry for that guy, E--
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
賭博...！
嘿嘿！有些風險你可以冒，有些則真的不該冒。
我忍不住為那個傢伙感到難過，E--

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Ergh...?
Damn, I can never remember his name. You'd think I wouldn't forget the guy whose rap I'm taking but... Eh, I'll remember once I sober up.
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
呃...？
該死，我總記不住他的名字。我以為我不會忘記那個我替他背黑鍋的傢伙，但是...呃，等我酒醒了就會想起來的。

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Hey, what do you think happens to Crusaders when they're framed and killed, huh? Where exactly do they go? Niflheim, Vahalla...?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
嘿，你覺得十字軍被陷害並殺害後會怎麼樣？他們到底會去哪裡？尼芙菲姆，瓦爾哈拉...？

scripts.text:
Hobbies?
What, you comin'
on to me?
scripts.translation:
愛好？
怎麼，你在跟我搭訕？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
A man's hobby is drinking, or didn't you know that? I happen to be real good at it too! Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
男人的愛好就是喝酒，你不知道嗎？我在這方面可是很在行的！嗚哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Speaking of which,
I haven't had a drink
for a looong time. Almost
a couple hours now.
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
說到這個，我已經很久沒喝酒了。差不多兩個小時了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Oooh, looks like you've got a tasty beverage I can enjoy. Bwahahaha! Gimmie~!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
噢噢，看來你有一瓶好喝的酒可以讓我盡興呢。哇哈哈哈！給我吧~！

scripts.text:
^3355FFBefore you can even think,
Royal Myst dips his hand into your inventory and helps himself to an Alcohol.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在你還沒反應過來之前，皇家迷霧的手已經伸進了你的物品欄，自顧自地拿了一瓶酒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Why mention it? You gonna bring me something I'll like? Cuz I'm more than willing to take it! Bwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
提它幹嘛？你是打算給我帶點我喜歡的東西嗎？那我可是求之不得哦！哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Oh yeah, this is the stuff. Not like that imitation junk they've been serving at the Bars nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
^333333*打嗝*^000000 沒錯，這才是好酒。不像現在酒吧裡賣的那些劣質仿製品...

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Hey! There anything you wanna
know about me? You did me a favor, so I'll tell you anything! Eeeeeverythiiing~~!!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
嘿！有什麼想問我的嗎？既然你幫了我，我就什麼都告訴你！所...所...有...的...事...情~~！！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Eh heh heh~
I just know
I'm gonna win
this time!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
嘿嘿嘿~
我就知道這次我一定會贏！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Wha...?
You wanna talk?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
什...？
你想聊天？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
What am I, your personal psychiatrist?! Lemme alone,
I'm busy here! Awright, now
which one do I bet on...?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷霧]
我是你的私人心理醫生嗎？！別煩我，我很忙！好吧，現在我該押哪一個呢...

scripts.text:

Welcome to Jawaii,
the paradise resort!
scripts.translation:
[九號球]
歡迎來到爪哇，天堂般的度假勝地！

scripts.text:

I'm the 'The Nineball', the security officer of Jawaii! If you encounter any trouble, or find any Singles, please don't hesitate to report to me as soon as you can~
scripts.translation:

我是“九號球”，爪哇的安保人員！如果您遇到任何麻煩，或者發現任何單身人士，請隨時向我報告~

scripts.text:

I've been told that there have
been many unruly drunkards here
lately, but it is in our best interest to make your experience here as enjoyable as possible.
scripts.translation:

我聽說最近這裡有不少不守規矩的酒鬼，但為了您的體驗，我們會盡最大努力讓您在這裡玩得盡興。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Why have you returned to
this lonely place of darkness?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你為何回到這孤獨的黑暗之地？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Please go back to the world
of the living. To be here is to suffer, such is the nature of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
請回到生者的世界去吧。
留在這裡只會受苦，這就是尼芙菲姆的本質。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Greetings...
{0}.
I've been watching you in the
world of the living. I see you've been busy looking for the truth about the 1st Squad, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你好...
{0}。
我一直在生者的世界注視著你。看來你一直在尋找第一小隊的真相，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I can provide you with the answers. After all, I'm the only member of the 1st Squad to retain all of my memories...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我可以給你答案。畢竟，我是第一小隊中唯一保留所有記憶的成員...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Heh heh...
Let me tell you everything
about the 1st Squad that's
been forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嘿嘿...
讓我告訴你關於第一小隊那些被遺忘的一切...

scripts.text: The Mission
scripts.translation: 任務

scripts.text: Fate of the 1st Squad
scripts.translation: 第一小隊的命運

scripts.text: Why are you in Niflheim?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在尼芙菲姆？

scripts.text: Thanks, I've heard enough.
scripts.translation: 謝謝，我聽得夠多了

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
First of all, the official record of our mission is misleading.
It contains some truth, based
on verbal evidence, but the most important details have been left out or changed.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
首先，關於這次任務的官方記錄具有誤導性。
雖然基於口頭證詞包含了一些事實，但最重要的細節被遺漏或篡改了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, we were secretly assigned
to find ^0000FFgodly artifacts^000000 by royal decree. In only three days, we succeeded and found Megingjard!
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
當時，我們奉王室密令，秘密尋找^0000FF神器^000000。僅僅三天，我們就成功了，並找到了雷神腰帶！

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, the records say the mission was unsatisfactory, correct? That would be because of me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
記錄上寫著任務結果令人不滿意，對吧？那是因為我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Are you aware that Megingjard
was a belt worn by gods? It was actually one of the keys to Thor's great strength. Another name for it is the 'Girdle of Might.'
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你知道雷神腰帶是眾神佩戴的腰帶嗎？它實際上是托爾強大力量的一部分來源。它的另一個名字是“力量腰帶”。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, if a human were to wear
that, there's a possibility that Megingjard would give him strength comparable to a god. Naturally, you'd be afraid of such a thing falling into the wrong hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
如果人類佩戴它，雷神腰帶可能會賦予他堪比神明的力量。自然，你會擔心這種力量落入錯誤的人手中。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In Rebarev Doug's mind, he
was the only person worthy of the belt since he considered himself the most religious person alive, and thus, closest to the gods.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
在雷巴列夫·道格看來，他是唯一配得上這條腰帶的人，因為他自認為是世上最虔誠的人，因此最接近神明。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He made it clear to us that only he would wear Megingjard. Although he was our leader, some of us felt uneasy about him wearing the belt and not giving it to his superiors, our mission objective.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他明確告訴我們，只有他才能佩戴雷神腰帶。雖然他是我們的首領，但我們中有些人對他佩戴腰帶而不將其交給上級（我們的任務目標）感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Naturally, I opposed him. He was clearly unbalanced, and it would be dangerous to give him control of such power. It led to something of a fist fight between us.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我自然反對他。他顯然精神失常，讓他控制如此強大的力量是危險的。這導致我們之間發生了一場鬥毆。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The rest of the squad couldn't
agree on whether or not we should simply obey our leader and let him have the belt. Some just wanted to complete the mission, while others were afraid of what might happen.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
小隊其他成員無法就是否應該服從首領並讓他擁有腰帶達成一致。有些人只想完成任務，而另一些人則擔心可能發生的後果。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev didn't wait for us to decide. He destroyed Megingjard into pieces, intending to keep most of it and somehow reconstruct it later, and only bring one piece to the Prontera Military.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
但雷巴列夫沒有等我們做決定。他將雷神腰帶拆成碎片，打算保留大部分並設法日後重組，只帶一片去普隆德拉軍隊。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He knew that he couldn't get
away with keeping all of Megingjard to himself, as the entire squad could easily discredit him.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他知道，如果他獨吞雷神腰帶，整個小隊很容易就能揭穿他。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev knew
that he could deceive his
superiors by giving them just a fragment of the artifact, and say that the rest of it was destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
但雷巴列夫知道，他可以通過只給上級一片神器，並聲稱其餘部分已毀，來欺騙他們。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I discovered his intention when
I found him taking Megingjard apart. Before I could stop him,
I was killed. That bastard had
a trap ready for me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
當我發現他在拆解雷神腰帶時，我察覺到了他的意圖。在我阻止他之前，我就被殺了。那個混蛋給我設了陷阱...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
After the mission, Rebarev Doug only gave a piece of the belt back to the higher-ups, and gave them
a different account than what had actually happened...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
任務結束後，雷巴列夫·道格只把腰帶的一片交還給了上級，並給出了與實際發生情況不同的說法...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Once the mission was completed, Rebarev Doug reported back to the Prontera Military with the intent of keeping most of Megingjard for himself.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
任務完成後，雷巴列夫·道格向普隆德拉軍隊報告，意圖將大部分雷神腰帶據為己有。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
For some reason, he has a very strong influence in the military hierarchy. Now, by this time, I'm sure the squad pretty much figured out that he killed me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
不知為何，他在軍隊高層中有很大的影響力。此時，我相信小隊成員已經意識到是他殺了我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev Doug expected this, and explained to his superiors that the squad was tempted by Megingjard's power and that I led some of us in a mutiny against him.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
但雷巴列夫·道格預料到了這一點，並向他的上級解釋，說小隊被雷神腰帶的力量誘惑，而我領導了一些人叛變。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He told his superiors that Megingjard was damaged as we
fought amongst each other, and that the fragment he gave them was all that remained.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他告訴上級，雷神腰帶在我們內鬥中受損，他交給他們的碎片就是僅存的部分。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Because of the confidential nature of our mission, the 1st Squad was disbanded and we weren't given the story Rebarev fed the beaureaucrats until it was too late.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
由於任務的機密性質，第一小隊被解散了。直到為時已晚，我們才得知雷巴列夫向官僚們編造的說法。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The squad was punished and
sent for disciplinary retraining for three months. During this time, specific memories were unnaturally erased from the squad members.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
小隊受到了懲罰，並被送去接受為期三個月的紀律再培訓。在此期間，小隊成員的部分記憶被非自然地抹去了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In the end, everyone was transferred to other squads and positions. My name had to be removed from all the records since hearing or reading my name might undo the brain washing.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
最終，所有人都被調往其他小隊和職位。我的名字必須從所有記錄中刪除，因為聽到或讀到我的名字可能會解除洗腦。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
However, they still needed an official scapegoat, so they used Royal Myst's name in the records. That's probably why he's been going through hard times right now.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
然而，他們仍然需要一個官方的替罪羊，所以他們在記錄中使用了皇家迷霧的名字。這可能就是他最近過得艱難的原因。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
And now Rebarev Doug has been studying godly artifacts based on the pieces of Megingjard that we found on that mission using kingdom research funds. Someday, he might be able to reconstruct the belt.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
現在，雷巴列夫·道格正在利用王國研究資金，基於我們在任務中發現的雷神腰帶碎片研究神聖神器。總有一天，他可能會重建這條腰帶。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
There are also
a few questions that
I've never been able
to answer.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
此外，還有幾個問題我一直無法回答。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I've never known why the King Tristram III ordered the research of godly artifacts. It also bothers me that Rebarev Doug is in charge of Megingjard's research. There must be some reason.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我從未知道為什麼特里斯坦三世國王下令研究神聖神器。雷巴列夫·道格負責雷神腰帶的研究也讓我感到不安。一定有什麼原因。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In any case, for the sake of Midgard, it will be your responsibility to find the answers.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
無論如何，為了米德加爾特，找到答案將是你的責任。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
There's not much a dead man
can do. But what's worse is that no one remembers me any more. I died alone and I'm still lonely in this place for the dead.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
死人能做的不多。但更糟糕的是，現在沒人記得我了。我孤獨地死去，在這個死人的地方依然孤獨。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The worst part of the squad
having their memories erased is
that Emma Searth has absolutely
no recollection of me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
小隊記憶被抹去最糟糕的部分是艾瑪·西爾斯完全不記得我了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Do you mind listening
to me for a while? You're
the only person with whom
I can talk about this...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你介意聽我說一會兒嗎？你是唯一能和我談論這些的人...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
From here, I've seen that Emma
is chasing her dream again, and
I'm happy for her. But it's still
not easy, knowing the woman you
love has totally forgotten you.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
從這裡，我看到艾瑪再次追逐她的夢想，我為她感到高興。但知道你深愛的女子完全忘記了你，這依然不容易。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I remember the first time I met her. I guess it was love at first sight. But I was too cowardly to confess my love, so I despaired when she joined the Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我記得第一次見到她的時候。我想那是一見鍾情。但我太膽小，不敢表白，所以當艾瑪加入十字軍時，我感到絕望。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
It took me a while, but I made up my mind to enlist as a Crusader
as well. I wanted to be closer to her so much.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我花了一段時間，但終於下定決心也加入十字軍。
我想離她更近一些。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, after all our adventures and good times together, I'm in the worst possible scenario.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
現在，在我們所有的冒險和美好時光之後，我陷入了最糟糕的境地。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I'm dead...
But I don't even have the consolation that she is
mourning my loss.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我死了...
但我甚至沒有她為我哀悼的安慰。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I suppose that's why I'm here
in Niflheim. I can't quite move on to heaven, Valhalla or anywhere else without her.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我想這就是為什麼我在尼芙菲姆。沒有她，我無法前往天堂、瓦爾哈拉或任何其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Anyway, go and visit the Crusader Headquarters. You might be able to learn more about Rebarev Doug and stop any new shadiness he might be plotting. Good luck, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
總之，去拜訪十字軍總部吧。你可能會了解到更多關於雷巴列夫·道格的資訊，並阻止他可能正在策劃的新陰謀。祝你好運，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Thank you for
listening to me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
謝謝你聽我說話...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
As a Crusader...
This is the best thing
I can do in return for
what you have done for me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
作為一名十字軍...
這是我能為你所做之事回報你的最好方式。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Listen...
I'm going to
imbue you with the
^666666last vestiges of my strength^000000...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
聽我說...
我將把^666666我最後的力量^000000注入你的體內...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
May the heavens
answer me as I call upon the
light of justice that empowers the defenders of truth, and threaten the enemies of peace.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
願上天回應我的呼喚，賜予真理守護者正義之光，並威懾和平的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
May you always shine with
the light of truth. Let the light within you eradicate the shadows
of deception, fear and malice.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
願你永遠閃耀真理之光。願你心中的光芒驅散欺騙、恐懼與惡意之影。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
By the holy power
invested in me, I humbly bestow upon you my remaining strength. Fight honorably, and do not lose sight of righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
憑藉賦予我的神聖力量，我謙卑地將我剩餘的力量賜予你。請光榮地戰鬥，切勿迷失正義。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Were you betrayed by fate as well, or are you simply a wanderer that's stumbled into this land of darkness?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你也是被命運背叛了嗎？還是隻是一個誤入這片黑暗之地的流浪者？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Hmm, the living don't deserve
to be in this realm of cold and suffering. But I can only help you escape by telling you what little
I know.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嗯，生者不配身處這寒冷與痛苦之地。但我只能告訴你我所知道的一點資訊，助你逃離。

scripts.text: Ask him about buildings.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於建築的資訊

scripts.text: Remove marks on mini-map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地圖上的標記

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I see. If you better understand Niflheim's layout, you have a greater chance of surviving and escaping.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我明白了。如果你更瞭解尼芙菲姆的佈局，生存和逃脫的機會就會更大。

scripts.translation: 女巫城堡

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 工具店

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Tavern
scripts.translation: 酒館

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The witch of Niflheim...
You can find her castle at the ^FF3355+^000000 mark I've made on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
尼芙菲姆的女巫...
你可以在小地圖上我做的^FF3355+^000000標記處找到她的城堡。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Hrrrm...
It seems that the living who wind up in Niflheim are seeking out the witch. But I don't quite understand what's so important about her.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嗯...
看來來到尼芙菲姆的生者都在尋找那位女巫。但我不太明白她為何如此重要。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The Tool shop? Here in Niflheim, they sell some unique items that
you can't buy anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
工具店？在尼芙菲姆，那裡出售一些你在別處買不到的獨特物品。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
You might want to see their
wares for yourself. I've drawn
a ^CE6300+^000000 on your mini-map to mark
its location.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你或許想親自去看看他們的商品。我在小地圖上畫了一個^CE6300+^000000標記來標示它的位置。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I've marked the location of the Weapon Shop at ^55FF33+^000000. There's nothing too special over there, though.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我在^55FF33+^000000標記處標示了武器店的位置。不過那裡沒有什麼特別的東西。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Tavern is at ^3355FF+^000000. They only sell drinks to the dead, though...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
酒館在^3355FF+^000000。不過他們只向死者出售酒水...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Choose 'Remove marks on mini-map' from the menu to remove all the building location marks I've made.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
從選單中選擇“移除小地圖上的標記”即可移除我做的所有建築位置標記。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Alright, all the marks I've made have been removed from your mini-map. If you want to check the locations in Niflheim again, go ahead and ask me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
好的，我做的所有標記都已從小地圖上移除。如果你想再次檢視尼芙菲姆的位置，儘管來問我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
You're gonna explore this place on your own? Pretty brave, aren't you? Just be careful: here in Niflheim, darkness reigns supreme.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你要獨自探索這個地方嗎？真勇敢啊。不過要小心：在尼芙菲姆，黑暗才是主宰。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I really wish that
Emma Searth could
remember me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我真希望艾瑪·西爾斯能記得我...
